en_title: 007 First Light Is Getting Free DLC Later This Week
cn_title: 《007 初露锋芒》本周推出免费DLC
subtitle: 新任务或将登场
opus_summary: IO Interactive确认《007 初露锋芒》将于10月2日推出免费DLC，具体内容尚未公布。更新可能涉及阿斯顿·马丁Valhalla及新任务，更多消息仍待官方披露。

paragraphs.en: 007 First Light is getting new, free DLC later this week.
paragraphs.cn: 《007 初露锋芒》本周晚些时候将推出新的免费DLC。

paragraphs.en: IO Interactive has teased the new DLC via a short video on its socials, confirming it will arrive on Thursday, October 2. The DLC will be free, but as of right now, IO is remaining tight-lipped about what it will include. However, based on some prior info, we can likely assume that this is the long-awaited Aston Martin Valhalla update. This content has been teased since launch in the game's main menu, and it appears it's finally being added to the game.
paragraphs.cn: IO Interactive在社交媒体上发布短视频预告，确认这款免费DLC将于10月2日周四推出，但目前仍未透露具体内容。不过，根据此前的信息，我们或许可以推测，它就是玩家期待已久的阿斯顿·马丁Valhalla更新。游戏自发售以来就在主菜单中预告过这部分内容，如今看来，它终于要加入游戏了。

paragraphs.en: This is expected to include a new TacSim mission featuring the Aston Martin Valhalla, which is used near the end of the game as part of a massive set piece. Given the extensive wait, it seems hard to imagine this will be just a short, single TacSim mission. This may add some other items that were revealed as part of a larger roadmap for the game , such as new game+, new gadgets, and other missions and content.
paragraphs.cn: 这次更新预计会加入一项以阿斯顿·马丁Valhalla为主角的新TacSim任务。这辆车曾在游戏接近尾声的一场大型演出场面中登场。玩家已经等了这么久，很难想象更新只会包含一项简短的TacSim任务。它也可能加入此前在游戏整体更新路线图中公布的其他内容，例如新游戏＋、新装备，以及其他任务和内容。

paragraphs.en: A free DLC is just around the bend. Tune in on October 1st. #007FirstLight #EarnTheNumber pic.twitter.com/9uCpNDTPth
paragraphs.cn: 「免费DLC即将到来。10月1日敬请关注。」#007FirstLight #EarnTheNumber pic.X.com/9uCpNDTPth

paragraphs.en: We'll just have to sit tight and wait to see what exactly is in store, though. 007 First Light is also set to get a new story DLC centered around Bawama, the pirate king warlord played by Lenny Kravitz. There's no firm release date for that content, though it's expected to be a premium add-on rather than a free update like what's coming later this week.
paragraphs.cn: 不过，具体会有哪些内容，我们还得耐心等待。《007 初露锋芒》还计划推出一款以海盗之王、军阀Bawama为主角的剧情DLC，这个角色由Lenny Kravitz饰演。该DLC尚无确切发售日期，而且预计会是付费追加内容，不会像本周晚些时候推出的更新那样免费。

paragraphs.en: 007 First Light's Nintendo Switch 2 port is also still coming down the pipeline. It was expected to be out by now, but was recently pushed to 2027 to ensure it was as good as it could be for fans. It's unclear for how long IO Interactive plans to support this game, as it has continued to drop updates for Hitman many years after its release. Even without a steady stream of post-launch content, 007 First Light has been a big hit. The game sold 4 million copies in its first three months , and sequels are expected to follow, though it will likely be a while before they materialize.
paragraphs.cn: 《007 初露锋芒》的任天堂Switch 2版本也仍在开发中。这个版本原本预计此时已经推出，但最近延期到了2027年，以确保玩家能获得尽可能好的体验。IO Interactive打算为本作提供多久的后续支持，目前尚不清楚；《杀手》发售多年后仍不断获得更新。即便没有持续不断的发售后内容，《007 初露锋芒》也已经大获成功：游戏在上市前三个月卖出了400万份，续作预计也会推出，不过恐怕还要等上一段时间。
